planets.name: K2-184 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of K2-184 with a 17-day year, found in 2018.

text.card: K2-184 b was found in 2018 by K2 as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around K2-184. Its orbit and size follow Castro-González et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
